exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-12T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix pm-
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: pm-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'

exec card board edit --description 'Board workstream description.'
exec card apply graph.json
exec card edit pm-2 --parent pm-1
exec card edit pm-4 --parent pm-2 --depends-on pm-3
exec card result set pm-3 'Dependency result memory.'

# Context is board-first, then broadest-to-nearest containment,
# then direct dependency results, then the current issue.
exec card show --context pm-4
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/context.txt
exec card --json show --context pm-4
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/context.json
